previous_assumption: Assumed a Platform Admin backend (cross-tenant organizations/users/catalogue administration, audit trail) could be scoped and built as part of the same MVP-gap-closing pass as the tenant-facing gaps.
correction: Confirmed there is no authorization tier above the Rental Company/Renter organization model anywhere in the backend: organizationTypeCodeSchema is a locked two-value enum (rental_company | renter, with a code comment confirming this is deliberate MVP scope), no super-admin/staff role or session shape exists, and no repository method queries across organizations without a caller's own organization_id. Did not build a Platform Admin backend or bypass; documented the required architecture instead (a staff-user concept, a new session/auth shape, cross-tenant-safe query layer) in docs/platform-admin-architecture-requirements.md. The frontend correspondingly ships an isolated, never-linked /platform-admin shell with every section labelled "Sample" (hardcoded, zero API calls) except Access & Roles, which shows FleetIP's real, static permission list from packages/contracts.
